result.reason: The added clause reaches the preferred position by providing up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, a machine-readable export within 30 days, and deletion certification. However, it goes beyond the playbook by requiring return and deletion of all Works, Confidential Information, and other Company materials—not merely Customer Data—and may duplicate or expand the existing treatment of Works in progress. The deletion obligation also lacks customary exceptions for legally required retention and backups. Accordingly, the operative language is substantively sufficient but not minimal and may alter unrelated rights.
